entries.title: Your merge click survives a fix that leaves the work as you approved it
entries.body: When your merge is refused and its crewmate fixes something that leaves the work as you approved it, such as a commit's title, the app keeps your click and merges once the checks pass. Before, only bringing the change up to date kept your click, and any other fix asked you again on a new card.
entries.noPicture: Nothing new on screen: the merge happens later without asking again.
